title: Construct K Palindrome Strings
description:
Given a string `s` and an integer `k`, return `True` if all characters of `s` can be rearranged into exactly `k` nonempty palindrome strings. Otherwise, return `False`.

## Examples

```text
Input: s = "annabelle", k = 2
Output: true
```

```text
Input: s = "leetcode", k = 3
Output: false
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= s.length <= 10^5`
- `s` contains lowercase English letters
- `1 <= k <= 10^5`
